messages.text:
We need a new "regions and partitions" option to make wallpapers like this, don't you think?

Please review the current state of the app as you consider your response
If we're gonna do different shapes, can we use the app's existing tools for importing images to define the shape for this?
Do we need a system for saving a library of imported shapes and paths so they can be reused across sessions and moved between without being lost?

Go ahead take another pass at the repo for context and search online for best practices and useful code and assets to help you build this out both technically and from a UI/UX standpoint and write up a detailed, specific plan in the repo
Awesome, get to work on a new branch please
Please keep going, as far as you can. You have my confidence and full autonomy. Be voracious and restless. When you must wait, find other things to do.
